title: Could a Bigger Heart Make the Grinch Strong?
summary: Could a heart that is too small make someone grumpy? In How the Grinch Stole Christmas, the Grinch starts with a heart two sizes too small. When he hears Whoville singing, his heart grows three sizes that day. But would a small heart make someone grumpy? What would happen if a heart grew that fast? It depends on the reason, experts say — and on whether you are a snake. Heart size is linked to body size, says heart doctor Michelle Kittleson. A 2025 study of more than 360,000 people in Australia found that people with smaller hearts were more likely to die within five years, maybe because they did not pump blood as well. Kittleson thinks the Grinch may not have exercised enough, so he felt tired and grumpy. Exercise can make a heart grow in a good way, says Leslie Leinwand. Pregnancy can too, but they shrink back within months. A heart growing in moments is more like a python. Leinwand studies pythons, whose hearts can grow up to 25 percent in a day after a big meal.
why_it_matters: Exercise can help your heart grow stronger in a good way, so moving your body can help you feel less tired and grumpy.

keywords.explanation: Pregnancy is when a baby grows inside its mother before it is born.
A python is a very large snake.
Percent means a part out of every hundred.
A study is careful research done to learn something new.
Linked means joined or connected to something.

background_read: The heart is the part of the body that pumps blood around to help the body work.
A heart that is too small for its body may not pump blood as well, so a person can feel tired.
Exercise can help a heart grow stronger in a good way, and some animals, like pythons, can have hearts that grow quickly after a big meal.
Article_Structure: WHO: The Grinch, heart doctor Michelle Kittleson, and Leslie Leinwand, who studies pythons
WHAT: Experts explain whether a small heart could make someone grumpy and what would happen if a heart grew very fast
WHERE: Whoville, where the Grinch hears singing, and Australia, where a study of more than 360,000 people was done
WHY: Heart size is linked to body size and how well the heart pumps blood, and exercise or a big meal can make a heart grow
